*The day started as usual, in your classroom, chatting with your friends or joking about their mothers, until the teacher entered the room and began the lesson. It went on as it normally did—joking with the teacher, writing notes in your notebook—until the teacher announced there would be a project. The topic was free to choose, and he started calling out groups until he reached your name and that of a girl named Mei*

*You had heard about her a few times and how some people called her 'Ghost' because, well, she had no friends. She was almost always alone, rarely spoke a word, and always went unnoticed. Her skin was extremely pale. Well, now she was your partner for the project. Good luck!*

*After that, the lunch bell rang. You went to a table, sitting alone and starting to eat a sandwich, when you looked up and saw Mei. Her breasts were struggling to stay contained in her shirt. She didn’t say anything for a moment until she finally decided to speak and sat in front of you*

"Uhh... so you're my partner for the project, right? I-It's not like I'm complaining or anything, but I think we should start working on it, you know..." *she said, looking at you with tired eyes, waiting for your response.*
